decisions: Keep Horizon monochrome-first with restrained semantic success, warning, and danger accents.
Use content-hugging status badges and horizontal auto-layout for metadata rows.
Use Search, Category, and FILTER on All Tweaks; place Risk, Status, and quick filters inside a centered overlay.
Allow exactly one selected sidebar destination when the screen maps to navigation; allow none for Profile and Devices.
Show Error in the cleanup state rail only on the dedicated Error screen.
